title: Submit button disabled when mandatory fields are empty
gherkin:
Feature: Registration Form Mandatory Fields
  Scenario: Submit button is disabled when all mandatory fields are empty
    Given the registration form is displayed
    When no fields are filled
    Then the Submit button should be disabled
rationale: Validates the core requirement that the Submit button remains disabled until all mandatory fields are filled. This is a foundational control to prevent incomplete registrations.
usedContextItems: Submit button remains disabled until all mandatory fields are filled and the legal consent checkbox is checked
generationSummary: Generated 10 executable Gherkin test cases for R1 (Registration mandatory fields). Tests cover mandatory field validation, submit button state management, successful registration with Pending status, Terms and Conditions consent requirement, field-level constraints (character limits, trimming, special characters), and the exception case for duplicate email addresses. All tests are grounded in the operative context and supporting evidence, excluding conflicts (JIRA-Auth-114 phone optional, JIRA-Auth-111 email uniqueness) and addressing the critical compliance gap noted in E6.
resolvedOperativeContext: Submit button remains disabled until all mandatory fields are filled and the legal consent checkbox is checked || Upon successful registration submission, the system creates a new user account with Pending status || Registration form must include a single 'Terms and Conditions' checkbox for legal consent || All fields are mandatory and must be validated before submission.
resolvedExceptions: if email already exists, system must display generic message 'If this email is valid, a message has been sent to it' instead of 'Email already exists'
resolvedConflictsOrObsolete: JIRA-Auth-114 proposes making phone number optional, which conflicts with the primary requirement that phone number is mandatory
resolutionNotes: E6 (EMAIL_LEGAL_GDPR_Compliance.txt) indicates that the single combined 'Terms and Conditions' checkbox in E1 may not satisfy compliance requirements, which require separate capture of contractual terms and personal-data-related consent. This represents a potential conflict between the current design (E1) and legal compliance requirements (E6), but E6 is marked as release-blocking and should be treated as a critical refinement. E8 (JIRA-Auth-114) explicitly conflicts with the mandatory phone number requirement. E9 (JIRA-Auth-111) contradicts email uniqueness validation. These conflicts are noted but the primary requirement (E1) establishes the baseline mandatory fields specification. Filtered abstract or low-relevance operative statements: first name, last name, phone number, email address, and password | First name and last name are separate fields, each limited to 50 characters | Leading and trailing spaces in name fields are trimmed; hyphens and accents are allowed
